title: Doesn't turn easily
text:
Doesn't turn easily. I got this to use with a sensory tile on the wall of my pediatric office. The idea is that you turn the tile and the fluid in it moves. I got this swivel base specifically for this as I figured it would turn easily. It requires two hands (for an adult) to rotate it and is very difficult for tiny hands, if not impossible.

While this isn't necessarily a problem for all clients, as it can help build up strength, I do feel the need to try to make it easier because it isn't really usable as is for my purpose. I plan of adding in some lubricant to try and get this this turning easier.
